from: review of a review via the coordinator
excess_only_even_spread: added to stage 0 and to EVERY comparison table from now on: the reviewer's stronger simple method. Predicted VIIRS 4 um radiance = measured-background-free MODIS excess spread evenly: (MODIS radiance - MODIS local median)^+ / band factor per cell, scored as block energy (L - VIIRS local median)^+. Because that score subtracts the same VIIRS median that the method adds, the method uses MODIS input ONLY (no VIIRS), and its scores are numerically identical to the earlier row 'true background + spread evenly' (0.783 on old validation vs plain spread evenly 0.714). The old 'oracle' label was misleading and is retired: the row is named 'excess-only even spread'. It joins the decision-line comparators (amendment 4) and the +0.05 rule of the fire-block score (amendment 4 stage-0 line 1 now reads: model minus the BEST of spread evenly and excess-only even spread >= 0.05, range above 0, positive in >= 75 % of qualifying episodes).
mask_holes: every measure (protocol-v2 summary and the amount measure) is reported twice: all blocks, and with blocks whose any pixel lies within 2 cells of a VIIRS placeholder hole (367 K, code 5) removed (protocol hole_mode 'near2'). No buffer exists in the tiles themselves; the pass lines are evaluated on the all-blocks version, the hole-free version is shown next to it and a disagreement is reported.
provenance: every score file carries the real git commit of the code that produced it (passed in from the repository checkout; the scorer refuses to run with an unknown commit), the protocol hash and the amendment-4 file hash.
